output.title: Which plans include a nurse callback?
output.draft_text:
Question: Which plans include a nurse callback?

Answer: A nurse callback is included with the following plans: [list of plans that include a nurse callback]. It is not included with [list of plans that do not include a nurse callback].

What a nurse callback is: [description of the nurse callback service, for example what the nurse helps with].

How to request one: Members on an eligible plan can request a nurse callback by [method of requesting a callback, such as phone number, member portal, or advocate transfer]. Requests are available [days and hours the callback service operates].

What to expect: A nurse will call the member back within [expected callback timeframe]. [Any cost to the member, or a statement that there is no additional cost].

How to confirm eligibility: To check whether a specific member's plan includes a nurse callback, [steps or system the advocate uses to verify plan eligibility].

Exceptions: [Any exceptions, such as employer group carve-outs, plan years, or regions where the service differs].

If the member's plan does not include a nurse callback: [alternative resource to offer, for example a nurse line or other support service].

Emergencies: [Approved emergency guidance, for example instructing the member to call emergency services].
